messages:
carlos: Hey team — after the org group merge that our IdP did this morning I can no longer open the org console. I hit a 403 Permission Denied immediately. Logged out/in, still 403. Anyone seen this after a group merge?

maya-support: Sorry you're blocked, Carlos. Can you share the org id and the affected user email? Also is this 403 for the UI only or are API calls failing too? :thinking_face:

carlos: Org: org_7kL8, user: carlos@acme.co. API keys still work for service calls (we can hit embeddings/generate) — it's just the console UI that shows: `403 PermissionDenied: user lacks role for org`. Screenshot in ticket #678.

liam-eng: Jumping in — thanks for the details. Two quick checks: 1) Did your IdP merge preserve the SCIM group externalId (UUID) or did it create a new group with the same display name? 2) Any chance the displayName had a trailing space or weird unicode? We've seen collisions cause role mapping drops.

carlos: I think the admin merged two groups in Okta and recreated one. Not sure about externalId. Display name looked identical in the UI.

jenna-idp: okta-bot logged the merge: `okta-bot: GROUP_MERGE: from G-4521 -> to G-9987 (displayName: "ACME Admins ")` — note the trailing space on the target group's displayName. That's likely it. SCIM mapping uses normalized external id but our mapping code also matches on displayName in the legacy path. Trailing space prevented a clean reconciliation, so the membership didn't map to the org role object.

maya-support: Workaround while we fix: we can add you back to the org via support service account. Carlos — are you ok with us doing that (requires a brief org-level edit, we'll annotate audit log)?

carlos: Yes please. We're blocked on deployments.

liam-eng: I'll run a safe rebind: `POST /internal/support/orgs/org_7kL8/memberships` with body `{ "email": "carlos@acme.co", "role": "org:admin", "reason": "emergency support rebind due to IdP merge" }` (internal endpoint). Will annotate audit and will revert if you want.

okta-bot: SCIM_SYNC: triggered manual resync for org_7kL8 by jenna-idp.

jenna-idp: We also pushed a short-term normalization patch to the SCIM importer to trim displayName whitespace and normalize unicode. We'll run a full resync — that should reconcile the group -> role mapping and restore memberships without manual adds.

liam-eng: Rebind complete for carlos@acme.co — confirmed `org:admin` in backend and console access restored for him. Also kicked a full role reconciliation job: `jobs/role_reconcile --org org_7kL8 --mode=full`.

carlos: Confirmed, I can access the console now. Thanks! :pray:

maya-support: Closing the support-side loop: root cause = IdP merge created group with displayName trailing whitespace which prevented legacy displayName-based mapping from reconciling memberships. Actions: 1) manual rebind for affected users (done), 2) SCIM importer normalization patch (deployed), 3) full role_reconcile run (completed). We'll follow up with a postmortem / preventative checklist for customers doing group merges.

jenna-idp: Follow-up: we're enabling the `normalizeDisplayName` flag in our SCIM connector and adding a warning for group merges that change externalId. We'll also send a note to partner Okta admins about safe merge steps.

carlos: Appreciate the quick turnaround. One request: can you add a console alert if a group's externalId changes during a merge? That would've saved time.

liam-eng: Logged feature request: `ENG-REQ-1024 — console alert on externalId changes during group merges`. Putting SRE and IDP teams as watchers.

maya-support: Marking thread resolved. If anything else pops up, reopen and we'll re-investigate. :white_check_mark:
